name: orchestrator
description: Dark desktop IDE that orchestrates local coding harnesses (OpenCode + Antigravity).

scripts.dev: pnpm build:contracts && concurrently -n sidecar,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @orchestrator/sidecar dev" "pnpm --filter @orchestrator/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @orchestrator/sidecar build && pnpm --filter @orchestrator/web build
scripts.tauri: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @orchestrator/sidecar build && pnpm --filter @orchestrator/desktop dev
